title: Dynegy Moss Landing Power Plant Hybrid: Phase 56K Exact-Record Decision
publisher: Moss Landing Power Company response posted by the California Public Utilities Commission
summary: The posted response addresses 28 conventional plant-audit findings: 13 are labeled Complete and 15 In progress. The filing is a company corrective-action response to a March 2025 GO 167 generation audit; it is not a final regulator determination and not the final investigation of the January 2025 battery fire. Phase 56K decision: Retain Partially Closed. The record adds a finding-level corrective-action denominator but does not close the selected battery-incident investigation or prove regulator acceptance of the company's status labels.
key_findings: Named record: Final regulator investigation and corrective-action closure.
Evidence state: Partially Closed to Partially Closed.
Continuation rule: Reopen when CPUC or another competent regulator publishes final January 2025 incident findings or verifies closure of the relevant corrective actions.
why_it_matters: The decision records an exact acquisition result, including a verified non-closure, without substituting an adjacent record.
ftfn_relevance: Separates current record status from entity performance.
Keeps denominator, attribution, limitation, and reopening rule attached.
evidence_limits: The status labels are company assertions in a regulator-posted response. The audit concerns conventional plant conditions and cannot substitute for the battery-fire investigation.
Final battery-incident findings, regulator-verified corrective-action closure, restored operation, availability, safety performance, and customer or grid outcomes.
No causal effect, entity ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
